test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"strength"** means the quality or state of being strong in character, mind, or body; (शक्ति / बल / मजबूती)

 
 
• **Example:** It takes great strength to forgive those who have wronged you.
 
 
 
• **"strength"** fits perfectly in the passage as it conveys that forgiving an injury is a sign of inner power and strong character. (मजबूत चरित्र / साहस)
 
 
• **Example:** Her strength of character allowed her to overcome resentment and forgive easily.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that correctly fills blank 2 is **"strength"**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usefulness** (उपयोगिता): The quality of being useful or beneficial.

 
 
• **Example:** The usefulness of this tool is evident in everyday tasks.
 
 
 
• **Intelligence** (बुद्धिमत्ता / समझदारी): The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.
 
 
• **Example:** Her intelligence helped her solve complex problems quickly.
 
 
 
• **Aptitude** (प्रवृत्ति / योग्यता): A natural ability to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** He showed a great aptitude for mathematics from a young age.
